wireContract: Send requires current account-bound server-verified Very Palm evidence before fresh reservation and submission. Missing proof returns verification_required with wallet_send purpose and intended persona. Reserved-send reads and same-key replay with stale proof retain the original record, with authorization null and verification_required true. Submitted/held outcomes remain privately readable and reconcilable without fresh proof or resubmission. The new authenticated IssueWalletSendVerificationIntent returns intent_id, very.web provider, wallet_send purpose and intended persona, using the existing canonical palm subject scope.

consumerRequirements.behavior: Use the typed wallet_send verification entry and preserve the intended persona. Withhold signing when verification_required is true; after successful verification re-read the same reservation. Preserve existing idempotency/recovery state and never create another send to recover an unknown outcome.
